The safedata research data management

The safedata package for R is the data discovery and download system for research data published within the broader safedata system for research data management. The safedata system is designed to manage heterogeneous field datasets collected as part of a wider research system, such as a widely used field site. The system has three components:

  • The safedata_validator package is used to enforce metadata and standarding formats on research datasets, ensuring that data are reusable and well-documented. The safedata_validator package also handles the publication of datasets to the Zenodo data archive, ensuring data accessibility and longevity.

  • The safedata_server web application provides data discovery by providing a searchable metadata database of published datasets, and also provides core resources across datasets, such as a gazetteer of sampling locations.

  • The safedata package itself then provides users with tools to search the metadata to find datasets of interest, download tools to maintain local copies of datasets of interest and tools to map spatial and taxonomic context onto datasets.

The safedata system was originally designed to manage the data outputs from the Stability of Altered Forest Ecosystems (SAFE) Project.
